_about: Public-domain Nathaniel West (1826-1906, Presbyterian, premillennial scholar) for the Word Hoard: 6 books and addresses from Internet Archive scans, 1861-1898, among them The Thousand Years in Both Testaments (1880), The Apostle Paul and the Any-Moment Theory (1893) and Daniel's Great Prophecy (1898). Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 22 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

west-thousand-years: The Thousand Years in Both Testaments (Chicago and New York: Fleming H. Revell; entered 1880)
west-apostle-paul-any-moment: The Apostle Paul and the "Any-Moment" Theory (Philadelphia: James M. Armstrong, 1893)
west-daniels-great-prophecy: Daniel's Great Prophecy, the Eastern Question, the Kingdom (New York: The Hope of Israel Movement; copyright 1898)
west-missionary-address: A Missionary Address, delivered in Brooklyn, October 1861, before the Synod of New York (New York: Mission House, 1862)
west-national-righteousness: Establishment in National Righteousness, and Present Causes for Thanksgiving, a sermon of 28 November 1861 (New York: John F. Trow, 1861)
west-grandeur-of-history: The Scientific and Theological Grandeur of History, inaugural address at Danville Theological Seminary, 1868 (Frankfort, Ky.: A. G. Hodges, 1869)

_alternates.west-second-coming: Second Coming of Christ: Premillennial Essays of the Prophetic Conference (Chicago: F. H. Revell, 1879; secondcomingofch00westrich): he edited it; the essays are by many speakers
_alternates.west-thomas-memorial: In Memory of Thomas Ebenezer Thomas (Cincinnati, 1875; inmemoryofthomas00westiala): his name is lost in the OCR
_alternates.west-daniel-copies: Second copies of Daniel's Great Prophecy (danielsgreatpro00westgoog, danielsgreatprop0000revn)

_excluded.west-sibley: The Ancestry, Life, and Times of Henry Hastings Sibley (1889): secular biography
_excluded.west-medical: The Medical Science and Profession (1877): commencement address
_excluded.west-namesakes: an earlier Nathaniel West (1794-1864) and an electrical engineer N. West
_excluded.west-late: reprints of 1936 and 1993; periodical articles without text
